correctness.rationale: Ren–Chen Theorem 1.2 gives every candidate form and the two-adic bound \(N<2^{3a+2}\). Odd lengths at least \(5\) contradict repunit growth; length \(3\) is excluded by a square-difference and strict odd-prime size comparison; even lengths at least \(6\) force two coprime odd prime factors; length \(4\) forces \(g+1\) a power of \(2\) and eliminates forms A/B/C by size and congruence. \(40=(1111)_3\) satisfies \(\sigma(40)=90=80+10\). Standalone standard-library checker passed 3,975 classified-number/base comparisons plus direct divisor-sum checks through \(10{,}000\); the infinite theorem is symbolic.
